text: Adapter discovery is documented from built-in adapters, `.outcomegraph/adapters/<type>/*.json`, and directories from `$OG_ADAPTER_PATH`. Each adapter definition must provide a manifest object and pass schema and interface checks. The manifest contract is a schema-versioned record with `schema_version: 2`, `type`, `name`, `implementation_version`, `interface_version`, `capabilities`, and `entrypoint`.
